title: Practice: fix it
description: Each starter has one bug. The brief says what you hear; find what is wrong.
author: Strudel Workshop

tracks.title: Fix it
tracks.blurb: Twelve broken loops, one bug each.

lessons.title: The silent hats
lessons.goal: The kick and clap play, but you hear no hats at all.
lessons.concept: Defining a part gives it a name. A name on its own makes no sound.

tasks.hint: Add hats to the stack: stack(kick, clap, hats).

summary: A part only plays once it is in the stack.

lessons.title: Four times too fast
lessons.goal: Everything races: the loop is over in a second.
lessons.concept: Strudel counts cycles per minute, and our cycle is a bar of four beats.

tasks.hint: setcpm(124/4): divide the BPM by the four beats in a bar.

summary: setcpm takes cycles per minute: BPM/4.

lessons.title: Sound not found
lessons.goal: The clap plays, but the kick is missing and the panel warns about a sound.
lessons.concept: Drum machine names are exact. Compare the kick’s bank with the clap’s.

tasks.hint: Spell the bank RolandTR909 on the kick line.

lessons.title: Eight kicks, not four
lessons.goal: The kick stutters: twice as many hits as you asked for.
lessons.concept: Brackets squeeze what is inside them into one step, and *4 repeats that step.

tasks.hint: Write the kick as s("bd*4"): one bd per step, four steps.

summary: [a b]*4 is eight hits; a*4 is four.

lessons.title: Where did the hats go?
lessons.goal: The hats are in the stack, but you hear only a faint tick, if anything.
lessons.concept: A low-pass filter at 80 Hz leaves almost nothing of a hi-hat, which lives above 3 kHz.

tasks.hint: Remove .lpf(80) from the hats, or raise it to .lpf(8000).

summary: A low-pass cutoff below a sound’s range silences it.

lessons.title: The delay fights itself
lessons.goal: The stab’s long echo keeps breaking up, and the hats echo oddly too.
lessons.concept: Strudel has one delay per orbit. Two parts with different delay settings on the same orbit overwrite each other.

tasks.hint: Put the hats on their own orbit: add .orbit(2) to the hats line.

summary: One delay (and one reverb) per orbit.

lessons.title: Duck target does not exist
lessons.goal: Pressing Play gives an error about a duck target orbit.
lessons.concept: Sidechain ducks another orbit. The kick says which one; it must be an orbit something plays on.

tasks.hint: Point the kick at the bass’s orbit: .duckorbit(2).

summary: duckorbit must name an orbit that plays.

lessons.title: The echo never stops
lessons.goal: The stab’s echoes pile up until everything is a wash of noise.
lessons.concept: Delay feedback is how much of each echo comes back round. At 1, nothing ever dies away.

lessons.title: A chord that plays one note at a time
lessons.goal: You wanted one chord stab, but you hear three notes in a row.
lessons.concept: In mini-notation spaces make steps; commas make a chord.

tasks.hint: Write the notes with commas: note("[c3,eb3,g3]").

summary: Commas stack notes into a chord; spaces put them in a row.

lessons.title: Distorted and crackly
lessons.goal: The kick crackles and the whole mix sounds harsh.
lessons.concept: Gain above 1 pushes a sound past full scale and it clips.

tasks.hint: Set the kick’s gain to 1 or less: .gain(.9).

summary: Keep every gain at 1 or below.

lessons.title: Assignment to constant
lessons.goal: Pressing Play gives an error about assigning to a constant, and nothing plays.
lessons.concept: A const can be defined once. Reusing the name later tries to overwrite it.

tasks.hint: Give the second part its own name: const ticks = s("hh*8")…, and stack(kick, hats, ticks).

summary: Every part needs its own const name.

lessons.title: Nothing plays
lessons.goal: Play does nothing: no sound, and the panel says the code made no pattern.
lessons.concept: Two slashes turn the rest of a line into a comment. Check the last line.

tasks.hint: Remove the // in front of stack(kick, clap).

summary: A // comment silences the whole line.
